# lib/usb module

USB CDC-ACM virtual serial port for the PIC18Fxx5x family. This page is the reference for the `lib/usb` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family, plus peer programs for extra transports where the driver has them. Build one with the repository build driver (--example names a peer), or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

| Family | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|
| PIC18Fxx5x | `usb-cdc` | [`lib/usb/examples/example_usb.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/usb/examples/example_usb.c) |
